name: myos-dev
description: Dev-only manifest for the test suite. NOT shipped: the product is payload/, which has no root package.json and needs none. This exists because `bun test` (unlike `bun run`) does not auto-install, so a tool whose deps are deferred to first use cannot be imported in a test without them resolvable here. Without `bun install` the dependent tests skip cleanly and say why.
